name: rioterm
description: Rio terminal for the web: the Rust VT core (librio) compiled to WebAssembly, with a canvas renderer and a headless API

scripts.prepack: node -e "['dist/index.js','dist/index.d.ts','wasm/librio_wasm.js','wasm/librio_wasm_bg.wasm'].forEach(f=>require('node:fs').accessSync(f))" || (echo 'refusing to pack without built dist/ and wasm/' && exit 1)
